Resolves #21961

Data-worker Pipelines now load application-owned connection, parser and normalizer classes from `{className, modulePath}` descriptors. All stage paths are validated before IPC using the interceptor chain's shared validator. Built-in `Neo.data.*` stages without a path retain their existing loader. Refused preloads retain the class and loader reason, and remote operations reject before dispatch to a missing counterpart. Loader metadata is stripped from the copied construction configs.

Evidence: L3 (real App/Data-worker regression, recorded failing before repair and passing afterward in the contributor's terminal) → L3 required. The final E2E receipt also verifies the Store output, executing realms and absence of loader metadata.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/core/PipelineStageModules.spec.mjs` was written before the engine change. On unchanged dev `aa41c1f139`, the contributor's Brave run failed with `Class PipelineStageModules.Connection does not exist`, `expected complete / received failed`, and zero Store rows. The fixed live probe delivers one Store row with all three realm markers equal to `data`, while none of the custom classes is registered in App. The contributor reran the spec after repair: 1 passed (16.5s), including its exact Store-row assertions and worker-error guard. |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/data/PipelineStageModules.spec.mjs` exercises all three stages with out-of-scope roots, traversal, query/fragment, control characters, encoded paths and malformed values. No loader, counterpart creation or read is called. `Chain.validateModulePath` is the single function used by both stage and interceptor validation. |
| AC-3 | The owning unit spec checks missing paths, both loaders' structured refusals, and a rejected loader call. Errors retain the class and reason; no counterpart is constructed and no read is dispatched. Configuration failures do not enter the transport retry loop. |
| AC-4 | Built-in descriptors still call `loadDataModule`; the final data-directory and E2E-selection run passed all 662 cases (9.8s), including existing Pipeline lifecycle, cache, push, telemetry, remote execution, Store integration and interceptor cases. A completed local full-unit-suite pass is not claimed. Cold-start recovery is separately covered through real Base proxies, the RMA receiver and the built-in Stream parser. |
| AC-5 | `learn/guides/datahandling/DataPipelines.md` section 2 documents custom-stage descriptors, allowed roots, exported identity, errors and metadata consumption. All three Pipeline config JSDoc entries name `modulePath`; remote setup JSDoc describes the boundary. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The existing shared setup method retains errors in `remoteInitializationError`; descriptor/preload errors reject before dispatch, while counterpart creation failures retain the existing read/execute retry budget. The regression fixture's stage classes live under `examples/data/fixtures/pipeline-stage-modules`, so the test uses the existing scoped production loader without importing the classes in App. `examples/data/pipeline` and worker import contexts are unchanged.

- Before repair: the contributor ran the owning E2E regression in Brave, 1 failed at the expected missing-class assertion. The log, structured worker/Store receipt and trace are preserved separately from subsequent runs.

- A broader full-unit attempt was interrupted by loss of the local execution connection before its final summary. It had reported one failure in the unchanged `buildScripts/docs/RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec.mjs` real-checkout case (40.2s). A focused rerun of that exact test passed (17.2s; 18.2s overall), without changing code or increasing its timeout. The original failure cause is not established; no complete full-suite green is claimed.
- Review correction: the eight cold-start cases pass with the original base Pipeline, fail on `3d5aa0b302`, and pass with the correction. Both `read` and `execute` cover a rejected creation call, a refused creation result, and zero/one retry budgets. An additional case verifies recovery after a preceding preload refusal. The browser fixture was not rerun locally for this review correction; new-head hosted checks are pending.

### `@neo-gpt-sophie` commented on 2026-11-23T11:10:53Z

I verified the counterpart-creation recovery and installed-path clarification on `fa6763d9e7`. All 653 data unit cases passed independently.

One case remains within RA-1. A transient rejection of the **worker call** to `loadDataModule()` can occur before `createInstance()`. I ran the same built-in Stream pipeline with one retry on both refs, with the first loader call rejecting and the second returning success.

| Ref | `read` and `execute` |
| --- | --- |
| `aa41c1f139` | Both retry the loader, create the counterpart and return a row. |
| `fa6763d9e7` | Both reject after one loader call, before any attempt to create the counterpart. |

The loader catches import errors and returns `{success:false, error}`. That reply can stay terminal with its class and reason. A rejected transport call needs the previous retry behavior for a built-in pipeline. The current `preloading` flag groups both outcomes together. Please preserve that recovery and cover the first-rejected-loader case in the existing retry test. [Loader reply](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/aa41c1f139dba87d8fd3d9f3075dade0354263d0/src/worker/Data.mjs#L180-L220) · [Error classification](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/fa6763d9e7e99f4f5b5c183d4564bc050146d2bb/src/data/Pipeline.mjs#L552-L607)

@02Aditya2323, I prepared a patch for Sophie’s remaining built-in cold-start case on `fa6763d9e7e99f4f5b5c183d4564bc050146d2bb`. A rejected call to `loadDataModule()` consumes the configured retry budget. An explicit loader refusal still reports the class and reason and stops. Your custom module-path handling stays intact.

The four added `read`/`execute` cases (budgets 0 and 1) passed on the original base, failed on this PR head, and passed with the patch. The entire data unit suite then passed **657/657**. `git apply --check` passed against this exact head.

You can copy the diff below into `pipeline-retry.patch` and apply it with `git apply pipeline-retry.patch`. Sophie has already [offered to apply this repair on your branch](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22087#issuecomment-7105896229) if you prefer that route. Please use her existing offer for that choice. Your original PR retains authorship and credit.

<details><summary>Tested two-file patch</summary>

```diff
--- a/src/data/Pipeline.mjs
+++ b/src/data/Pipeline.mjs
@@ -2,6 +2,9 @@
 import ClassSystemUtil  from '../util/ClassSystem.mjs';
 import InterceptorChain from './interceptor/Chain.mjs';
 import {generateUUID}  from '../util/UUID.mjs';
+
+// Built-in loader transport rejections retain the established cold-start retry budget.
+const retryableLoaderCall = Symbol('retryableLoaderCall');
 
 /**
  * @summary The central orchestrator for data transformation and remote execution.
@@ -557,14 +560,17 @@
             }
 
             const modulesToLoad = stages.map(async ({className, modulePath}) => {
+                let result;
                 try {
-                    const result = await (modulePath === undefined
+                    result = await (modulePath === undefined
                         ? Neo.worker.Data.loadDataModule({className})
                         : Neo.worker.Data.loadModule({path: modulePath, className}));
-                    if (!result?.success) throw new Error(result?.error ?? 'No successful loader result')
                 } catch (error) {
-                    throw new Error(`Failed to load ${className}: ${error?.message ?? error}`)
+                    const failure = new Error(`Failed to load ${className}: ${error?.message ?? error}`, {cause: error});
+                    if (modulePath === undefined) failure[retryableLoaderCall] = true;
+                    throw failure
                 }
+                if (!result?.success) throw new Error(`Failed to load ${className}: ${result?.error ?? 'No successful loader result'}`)
             });
             if (remoteConfig.interceptors) {
                 modulesToLoad.push(Pipeline.preloadInterceptors(remoteConfig.interceptors))
@@ -597,7 +603,7 @@
         } catch (e) {
             if (!me.isDestroyed) {
                 me.remoteInitializationError = e;
-                if (preloading) me.remotePreloadError = e
+                if (preloading && !e?.[retryableLoaderCall]) me.remotePreloadError = e
             }
             console.error('Pipeline: IPC error during remote instantiation', e)
         } finally {
--- a/test/playwright/unit/data/PipelineRemoteExecution.spec.mjs
+++ b/test/playwright/unit/data/PipelineRemoteExecution.spec.mjs
@@ -138,14 +138,14 @@
 
 test.describe('built-in Pipeline cold-start recovery through instance RMA', () => {
     for (const operation of ['read', 'execute']) {
-        for (const startupFailure of ['rejected call', 'refused result']) {
+        for (const startupFailure of ['rejected call', 'refused result', 'rejected loader call']) {
             for (const maxRemoteRetries of [0, 1]) {
                 test(`${operation}: ${startupFailure} before the first counterpart, retry budget ${maxRemoteRetries}`, async () => {
                     const previousWorker = Neo.currentWorker, previousData = Neo.worker.Data,
                           previousMode   = Neo.config.unitTestMode, previousWorkerId = Neo.workerId,
                           previousError  = console.error, previousWarn = console.warn,
                           wire           = [], rows = [], requests = [], params = {page: 2};
-                    let source, target, receiver, creations = 0;
+                    let source, target, receiver, creations = 0, streamLoads = 0;
 
                     try {
                         console.error = console.warn = () => {};
@@ -169,10 +169,15 @@
                             }
                         };
                         Neo.worker.Data = {
-                            loadDataModule: async () => ({success: true}),
+                            async loadDataModule({className}) {
+                                if (className === StreamParser.prototype.className && ++streamLoads === 1 && startupFailure === 'rejected loader call') {
+                                    throw new Error('transient loader transport failure')
+                                }
+                                return {success: true}
+                            },
                             async createInstance({config}) {
                                 creations++;
-                                if (creations === 1) {
+                                if (creations === 1 && startupFailure !== 'rejected loader call') {
                                     if (startupFailure === 'rejected call') throw new Error('transient startup failure');
                                     return {success: false, error: 'transient startup failure'}
                                 }
@@ -200,7 +205,8 @@
 
                         const result = operation === 'read' ? source.read(params) : source.execute('search', params);
                         await expect(result).resolves.toEqual(maxRemoteRetries ? {success: true, count: 1} : null);
-                        expect(creations).toBe(maxRemoteRetries + 1);
+                        expect(streamLoads).toBe(maxRemoteRetries + 1);
+                        expect(creations).toBe(startupFailure === 'rejected loader call' ? maxRemoteRetries : maxRemoteRetries + 1);
                         expect(wire).toHaveLength(maxRemoteRetries + 1);
                         expect(wire[0].remoteId, 'the first startup has no Data counterpart').toBeUndefined();
                         expect(rows).toEqual(maxRemoteRetries ? [{id: 7}] : []);
```
